from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    points = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    height = max(r for r, c in points) + 1
    width = max(c for r, c in points) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in points):
                for dr, dc in points:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
